verdict.rationale: Completing a core transaction (applying, registering, filing, or paying) online is a fair question for a government immigration agency, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no AIMA published pages describing any online application or payment. The only item is a probe whose TLS connection failed, so nothing on the host was fetched; that failure says nothing either way about online-filing capability, so the verdict is none from absence of evidence, not a demonstrated gap.
